A snare drum is struck with wooden drumsticks as percussion, not blown as a woodwind.
Clifford the Big Red Dog was created by author-illustrator Norman Bridwell, not Dr. Seuss.
The knee meniscus is a shock-absorbing crescent pad of fibrocartilage, not a bone.
A constellation is a mapped pattern of distant stars, not water droplets.
Surfing rides warm ocean waves in the Summer Olympics, not the Winter Games.
A tire iron loosens car lug nuts in a trunk rather than helping with homework.
Sirius (the Dog Star) is an individual bright star inside Canis Major, not a constellation.
Players sit in the penalty box during ice hockey fouls, not chess matches.
White borax powder looks like baking soda, yet it is an inedible household laundry cleaner.
A ceramic coffee mug sits in a kitchen cabinet all day and night.
Kung Fu Panda is a DreamWorks Animation franchise, not a Pixar movie.
Spinach is harvested for its above-ground green leaves, not its roots.
Saffron consists of dried red crocus flower stigmas, making it a floral spice rather than a leaf herb.
An earthworm has a soft segmented muscular body with zero shell or armor.
The Ugly Duckling was penned by Danish author Hans Christian Andersen rather than the Brothers Grimm.
A silverfish is a six-legged insect, but it belongs to a primitive wingless order that cannot fly.
Argyle is a diamond-checkered knitting pattern, not a shade of blue.
Velociraptor was a sickle-clawed carnivorous predator, not a herbivore.
A wooden broomstick sweeps porch dust rather than supporting the human skeleton.
Six Flags is an amusement roller-coaster chain, not a National Park.
